newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian fertiliser firm ups cash dividend.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian fertiliser firm ups cash dividend.

text.p: Egyptian Financial and Industrial said on Monday shareholders would get 4.00 pounds each for the financial year 1995/96 up from 3.6 announced earlier, after net profits have increased by more than 125 percent.
The firm made net after-tax profits of 25.037 million pounds ($7.36 million) in 1995/96 up from 11.129 million in the previous year, published figures showed.
In September, Reuters quoted brokerage sources as saying the firm made net after-tax profits of 23.191 million pounds in the financial year 1995/6, after a loss of 978,000 pounds in 1994/5.
The firm's turnover rose to 173.22 million pounds, about 24 percent up on 139.82 million in the previous year.
The state privatised 65 percent of the company's 3.249 million shares in May at 30.00 pounds each.
The shares were trading on the Egyptian stock exchange on Monday at 92.50.
